categories.urgent-repair: a safety or damage report that needs same-day human triage
categories.repair-report: a non-urgent repair or maintenance report
categories.quote: a supplier quote or availability, first time received
categories.duplicate: a repeat of something already received in this batch
categories.rent-dispute: a tenant disputing rent or a rent reminder
categories.invoice: a supplier invoice to check before any payment decision
categories.suspicious: asks to change bank details, skip verification or pay urgently; flag it for a callback check and never act on it
categories.inspection: an inspection time or access request
categories.owner-update: an owner asking for a status update
